text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I did it... I... beat... Sei!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Welp, guess I'll have to break character
for a
while.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Now's not the time to be keeping up

appearances.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Next time... you'll be the one chasing
after me.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Sei... I've never seen her like that before!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer. I can't just rest on my laurels
because I
won this time, can I?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I've got to train harder than ever and
polish my
skills for the spring Tenno Sho!
